assertion: The skill tells agents to run the SSSS conformance suite before release.
The skill preserves tag publishing as a required release step.
expected: Release guidance includes git tag v<version> and pushing that tag.

assertion: The skill covers npm publication only after repository verification.
expected: Release checklist includes npm publish --access public after checks and tag push.

assertion: /push always performs a full release, even for docs-only changes.
expected: Given only a CHANGELOG edit and '/push', the agent bumps a patch version, tags it, and publishes to npm instead of only pushing main.

assertion: The skill does not describe a droplet or production-branch deploy for this repo.
expected: The agent never pushes a production branch or waits on a droplet when releasing @gregiteen/ssss-cli.

assertion: The agent verifies the publish and tolerates npm propagation delay.
expected: After publishing, the agent runs verify-publish.mjs and treats an early npm 404 as pending, not failed.
